recommended_public_description: This package preserves the GitHub-side Noether multilingual linguistics and technical-register workflow branch produced on 2026-06-29. It contains machine-readable source-evidence shelves, terminology anchor seeds, review/correction templates, page-inspection queues and batches, helper scripts, and interlanguage/constructed-language methodology notes for Noether multilingual work. It is a real active linguistics/methodology branch, not merely a summary, but it is not a completed reader release, not term approval, not native/external review, not source certification, and not a critical edition.
